I have been farming this land in Iringa since I was a boy, and I learned everything from my father and from watching what works. I will put two bags of DAP at planting and one bag of urea when the maize is knee-high on this plot, because that is what has given me good cobs before. I will also spread two ox-cart loads of manure on this plot since I own it and I want to keep the soil strong. I will plant improved seed that I bought from the dealer in town — the same kind my neighbor used last season that grew very tall — and I do not use chemical sprays for weeds because my family pulls them by hand. My wife and children will work this plot for about sixty days over the season, and I will hire extra hands for about twelve days when the weeding and harvest are heavy.
